core_problem_solved: To provide a standard, Type 4 JDBC driver for Java applications to connect and interact with PostgreSQL databases.
key_features: Implemented the Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) API for PostgreSQL.
era_and_niche: The original, legacy Maven coordinate for the official PostgreSQL JDBC driver, used for many years before Java project naming conventions standardized around reversed domain names for groupIds.
reason_for_obsolescence: This specific Maven coordinate is **obsolete**. The project officially moved to a new, more standard groupId to follow modern conventions. The direct and actively maintained successor is **`org.postgresql:postgresql`**.
